We wanted the Wordrunner to not just track your words, but to enhance your entire writing experience. FAQ

What is a 75% mechanical keyboard?

A 75% mechanical keyboard is a compact version of a full-sized keyboard. It typically has around 80-84 keys, keeping the essential ones like the function row and arrow keys, but removing the number pad and some other keys to save space. It's perfect for users who want a smaller, more portable keyboard without sacrificing functionality.

Why should I choose a 75% mechanical keyboard over other sizes?

A 75% keyboard offers the best balance between compact design and full functionality. It saves desk space, is more portable, and retains most of the essential keys that full-sized keyboards have. If you need portability without sacrificing functionality, it's an excellent choice.

Are 75% mechanical keyboards good for gaming?

Yes, many 75% mechanical keyboards are excellent for gaming. The reduced size doesn’t affect performance, and the mechanical switches provide fast, responsive key presses that are ideal for gaming. Plus, the compact layout can make your setup look cleaner and more organized.

Can I customize a 75% mechanical keyboard?

Yes, many 75% mechanical keyboards offer customization options. You can usually change key switches, remap keys, and adjust lighting. Some even allow you to customize macros and configure multiple device connections, making them ideal for people who want a personalized experience.

What should I consider when choosing a 75% mechanical keyboard?

When choosing a 75% mechanical keyboard, consider factors such as the type of switches (linear, tactile, or clicky), keycap material (PBT is more durable), connectivity options (wired, wireless, or Bluetooth), and build quality (aluminum or plastic). Also, look for additional features like customizable RGB lighting, hot-swappable switches, and ergonomic design for comfort during long typing or gaming sessions.

Are 75% keyboards compatible with both Windows and Mac?

Most 75% mechanical keyboards are compatible with both Windows and Mac operating systems. Some even offer a switchable layout for easy use on both platforms, so you don’t have to worry about compatibility issues.

## FAQ

### What is a 75% mechanical keyboard?

A 75% mechanical keyboard is a compact version of a full-sized keyboard. It typically has around 80-84 keys, keeping the essential ones like the function row and arrow keys, but removing the number pad and some other keys to save space. It's perfect for users who want a smaller, more portable keyboard without sacrificing functionality.

### Why should I choose a 75% mechanical keyboard over other sizes?

A 75% keyboard offers the best balance between compact design and full functionality. It saves desk space, is more portable, and retains most of the essential keys that full-sized keyboards have. If you need portability without sacrificing functionality, it's an excellent choice.

### Are 75% mechanical keyboards good for gaming?

Yes, many 75% mechanical keyboards are excellent for gaming. The reduced size doesn’t affect performance, and the mechanical switches provide fast, responsive key presses that are ideal for gaming. Plus, the compact layout can make your setup look cleaner and more organized.

### Can I customize a 75% mechanical keyboard?

Yes, many 75% mechanical keyboards offer customization options. You can usually change key switches, remap keys, and adjust lighting. Some even allow you to customize macros and configure multiple device connections, making them ideal for people who want a personalized experience.

### What should I consider when choosing a 75% mechanical keyboard?

When choosing a 75% mechanical keyboard, consider factors such as the type of switches (linear, tactile, or clicky), keycap material (PBT is more durable), connectivity options (wired, wireless, or Bluetooth), and build quality (aluminum or plastic). Also, look for additional features like customizable RGB lighting, hot-swappable switches, and ergonomic design for comfort during long typing or gaming sessions.

### Are 75% keyboards compatible with both Windows and Mac?

Most 75% mechanical keyboards are compatible with both Windows and Mac operating systems. Some even offer a switchable layout for easy use on both platforms, so you don’t have to worry about compatibility issues.
